stories.title: Teen and adult sister killed in Midtown St. Louis shooting; 15-year-old injured
stories.summary: A 14-year-old boy and his 27-year-old sister died and a 15-year-old was critically injured in a shooting Sunday in Midtown. Police took a 17-year-old into custody.

stories.title: St. Charles County approves grant for new license plate readers; data regulation bill delayed
stories.summary: St. Charles County Council okays funding for five new license plate readers amid public outcry over privacy issues, delaying a decision on data policy regulations.

stories.title: Trump pauses Iowa lead detonation, tying it to a court and a Democrat. Missouri Republicans had already objected
stories.summary: A Nov. 20 letter from Graves, Schmitt and Hawley pressed the Army. A retired Missouri regulator weighs the risk.

stories.title: Galleria owner markets mall for sale amid financial struggles
stories.summary: Owners of the Galleria have been working to reinvent the mall amid shifting consumer habits and growing retail competition.

stories.title: North St. Louis shooting leaves 14-year-old girl critically injured
stories.summary: A 14-year-old girl is hospitalized after being shot in the neck Sunday night in north St. Louis, police say.

stories.title: Woman dies at rural Iron County home; investigation underway
stories.summary: A death investigation is underway after a woman was found unresponsive and later died Thursday at an Iron County home.

stories.title: Kimmswick dissolves its police department
stories.summary: The Jefferson County Sheriff's Office will take over all law enforcement in Kimmswick after the Board of Aldermen voted to dissolve the city's police department.

stories.title: Delta flight delays disrupt Thanksgiving travel for passengers heading to St. Louis
stories.summary: A Delta technical issue delayed thousands of flights Sunday, disrupting Thanksgiving travel plans for passengers heading to St. Louis.

stories.title: From Denver to St. Louis: A remarkable friendship takes center stage at the Musial Awards
stories.summary: The friendship between soccer star Carson Pickett and Hayden Stine, 10, was among the inspiring stories honored at the 2026 Musial Awards in St. Louis.

stories.title: Friend fears for Missouri woman detained by immigration agents at St. Louis airport
stories.summary: Gelsashley Lacayo Mendoza remains in the Ste. Genevieve County Jail as her boyfriend disputes federal officials' claims about her immigration status.

stories.title: Woman shot, killed Saturday in south St. Louis
stories.summary: The deadly shooting happened at about 1:35 a.m. Saturday on California Avenue, St. Louis police said.

stories.title: Teen killed, another seriously injured in Ste. Genevieve crash
stories.summary: An 18-year-old girl was killed and a 16-year-old boy was seriously injured after their car overturned several times in Ste. Genevieve, troopers said.
